auth.description:
### To obtain your Vimeo API access token, follow these steps:

1. Login to your Vimeo account
2. Create your app on Vimeo, navigate to https://developer.vimeo.com/apps
3. After creating the app, copy **Client identifier** and fill it to **Client ID** field below.
4. Scroll down and Copy **Client secrets** and fill it to **Client Secret** field below.
5. Scroll down and find "Your callback URLs" section, and add new URL. Make sure you copy the **Redirect URL** from the field below to Vimeo's redirect URL.
6. Click **Connect** from below and allow access to your account.
7. Save

aiMetadata.description: Uploads a new video to the authenticated user's Vimeo account by pulling it from a public video URL (the file must be reachable via that link; this is a pull-based upload, not a direct file transfer). Use to publish video content programmatically, optionally setting privacy, license, content rating, language, and a destination folder. Not idempotent: each call creates a separate video, so repeating it produces duplicates. Requires a token with the upload scope.

7. Sla

### Pour obtenir votre jeton d'accès à l'API Vimeo, suivez ces étapes :

1. Connectez-vous à votre compte Vimeo
2. Créez votre application sur Vimeo, accédez à https://developer. imeo.com/apps
3. Après avoir créé l'application, copiez **Identifiant client** et remplissez-le dans le champ **ID client** ci-dessous.
4. Faites défiler vers le bas et copiez les **secrets du client** et remplissez-le dans le champ **Secret du client** ci-dessous.
5. Faites défiler vers le bas et trouvez la section "Vos URLs" et ajoutez une nouvelle URL. Assurez-vous de copier l'**URL de redirection** du champ ci-dessous vers l'URL de redirection de Vimeo.
6. Cliquez sur **Connecter** à partir du bas et autorisez l'accès à votre compte.
7. Enregistrez

pt.\n### To obtain your Vimeo API access to:
### Para obter o seu token de acesso da Vimeo, siga estes passos:

1. Faça login na sua conta Vimeo
2. Crie seu aplicativo no Vimeo, navegue até https://developer. imeo.com/apps
3. Depois de criar o aplicativo, copie **Identificador do cliente** e preencha-o para o campo **ID do cliente** abaixo.
4. Desça e copie **Segredos do cliente** e preencha-o para o campo **Segredo do Cliente** abaixo.
5. Deslize para baixo e encontre a seção "Suas URLs de chamada" e adicione uma nova URL. Certifique-se de copiar o **URL de redirecionamento** do campo abaixo para o URL de redirecionamento do Vimeo.
6. Clique em **Conectar** abaixo e permita o acesso à sua conta.
7. Salvar
